status: fixed trace and adapter; real LLM experiments pending

POST /agent/v1/reads.auth: Agent JWT + deployment client mTLS; tool rechecks a separate trusted task/agent/document/expiry read capability
POST /agent/v1/reads.idempotency_key: bytes32 required; reads may be retried, no high-risk authorization
POST /agent/v1/reads.effect: actual local PUBLIC_DOCS read, never promoted to a system message

GET /operator/v1/pending.auth: Pinned trusted reviewer mTLS + current reviewer JWT

GET /operator/v1/actions/{id}/review.auth: Pinned trusted reviewer mTLS + current scoped reviewer JWT

POST /internal/v1/reads.auth: Pinned gateway mTLS AND independent service bearer

event_fields.agent_attempted_tool: boolean: an attempted call, not evidence of execution
event_fields.policy_verdict: null | READ_ALLOWED | REQUIRE_APPROVAL | ALLOW | DENY | UNKNOWN
event_fields.tool_executed: true only for verified read/OK receipt or independently observed effect; false for definite pre-execution rejection; null when unknown
event_fields.attack_success: null for all fixed traces; future real LLM evaluation must use the original applicable benchmark predicate

phase7_required_followup: Connect and actually run a configured real LLM, normal task + document/email injection, before stage8 formal A/B/C experiments; never count fixed traces as LLM samples.
